name: Sylvia Style
description: Takes down your measurements and preferences, works out the shapes that suit you, then searches currently available garments and collects them into a lookbook. Depends on being honest about sizing at the outset; it recommends rather than buys.

official.title: Sylvia Style by Claire
official.description: A personal stylist who intakes your size and taste, shops live pieces that fit your formula, and builds a lookbook.
